lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to write His words in a book and promises to restore Israel and Judah from captivity.
The LORD will break the yoke off Jacob's people, and they will serve Him and Solomon their king.
The LORD will save Jacob out of a distant place and will not completely destroy him, but will discipline him justly.
The LORD will heal the wounds of Zion, and the city will be rebuilt on her own ruins, with thanksgiving rising from the people.
Their leader will come from among their own, and the LORD will be the God of all the families of Egypt.
